fields.name: fullUntil
fields.note: present only when openForRequests is false, e.g. 'September'

filtersOrSort: category (query param ?category=, re-fetched via getMentors(category); also re-derived client-side as the union of categories present in the unfiltered getMentors() call to build the chip row)
reads.pagination: none — full list returned in one response, no page controls or infinite scroll in the UI
n/a — single record fetched by id (getMentor(id) resolves to Mentor | null, no matching id renders a not-found UI state)

payload.name: mentorId
payload.note: route-derived (mentor.id), passed as the function's first argument / path segment, not part of the JSON body

payload.name: topics
payload.note: multi-select subset of mentor.topics the requester picked; UI requires at least 1 selected

payload.name: note
payload.note: free-text problem description; UI requires non-empty trimmed text

payload.name: slot
payload.note: client-composed label, e.g. 'Tue 19, evening' — built from a selected upcoming-weekday date plus a morning|evening choice; not sent as separate date/time fields

expectedResponse.note: response is a thin ack shape ({id,status}); the richer MentorRequest type in src/types/mentors.ts (mentorId, topics, note, slot, sentAt) is defined but not what this action actually returns — the sheet's confirmation screen re-displays the values it already held client-side (mentor name/topics/slotLabel), not fields from the response

authContext.note: none of this screen's own files (mentors/page.tsx, mentors/[id]/page.tsx, MentorRequestSheet.tsx, MentorBookButton.tsx, mentors.ts, mocks/mentors.ts) call creatorGates(), a session hook, or any account-type/tier check — the screen renders and lets any visitor request a session with no gate observed in-scope. requiresAuth:true is an assumption from the screen living under the (app)/ route group (session/auth wrapping, if any, is enforced in src/app/(app)/layout.tsx and src/app/(app)/components/SessionGate.tsx, both out of this screen's scope per scan-map.json) rather than something this screen's own code enforces or checks.

special.pollingOrRefresh: none — fetch-on-navigation only, no setInterval/polling anywhere in scope
special.notes: MentorRequestSheet computes 'the next 3 upcoming weekdays' entirely client-side (upcomingWeekdays()) using the browser's local Date — not a backend read.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: getMentors()/getMentors(category) resolves with a non-empty array

mentors.length === 0 after filtering by category — reachable both by picking a chip that legitimately empties (not possible today since chips are derived from the unfiltered list, so every chip has ≥1 result) and by a user hand-editing the URL to an arbitrary ?category= value not present in the data
getMentors()/getMentors(category) throws inside the page's try/catch, rendering ErrorState
uiStatesHandled.note: src/lib/api/mocks/mentors.ts's getMockMentors() never throws under any input — pure array filter with a fixed delay. This path is currently dead code exercised by no reachable mock condition; it only becomes reachable once a real backend can return a network/5xx error.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: the 250-280ms mock delay() while getMentors() is in flight
uiStatesHandled.note: MentorsPage is an async server component with no sibling loading.tsx in src/app/(app)/services/mentors/ — there is no skeleton/spinner state defined by this screen's own code at all, mock or real. Whether a loading state is ever shown to the user depends on Next.js's default streaming/suspense behavior at a layout this screen doesn't own, not on anything in scope here.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: getMentor(id) resolves to a non-null Mentor
getMentor(id) resolves to null (MOCK_MENTORS.find() finds no match for the id) — rendered via ErrorState 'Mentor not found'
uiStatesHandled.note: reachable today simply by navigating to /services/mentors/<any-unknown-id>; no try/catch wraps getMentor(id) itself, so a thrown error (vs. a null result) is not handled by this screen's own code.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: mentor.openForRequests === false — MentorBookButton renders a disabled Button showing 'Full until {fullUntil}' or 'Not taking requests right now' instead of opening the sheet
sheet opened via MentorBookButton, or after reset() from 'Done'/'Browse other mentors'
canSend is true and send() is called; phase set to 'processing' while requestMentor() is in flight
requestMentor() resolves successfully; phase set to 'done'

uiStatesHandled.state: request sheet: send failure (silent revert, no error message)
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: requestMentor() throws inside send()'s catch block, which just calls setPhase('idle') with no toast/error UI shown to the user
uiStatesHandled.note: src/lib/api/mocks/mentors.ts's requestMockMentor() never throws — always resolves after a fixed 500ms delay. This failure path exists in the component but has no mock condition that can trigger it today; once wired to a real backend it becomes reachable, and currently gives the user zero feedback that anything went wrong (the sheet just silently returns to the empty form).

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 6 · Mentor — what to ask, when, and that it is free
7 · Request — topic, the real problem, a date

uiStatesDesignedNote: Matched via design/screens/WAWU Service Apply Mentors.dc.html, frames 5-7b (labeled '5–7 · Mentors' in the file's own section header). The design source depicts only success-path frames for browse, detail, the request sheet, and the post-send confirmation — it does NOT define loading, empty, error/not-found, disabled-booking (full mentor), or an in-flight/processing frame for the request sheet; those states exist only in uiStatesHandled above, as code-only additions beyond what the design specifies.
